body:
> fwiw, this seems to be an issue in rpm actually
> 
> [rpm-software-management/rpm#2323](https://github.com/rpm-software-management/rpm/issues/2323)
> 
> can you check which version you're using?

Hi @caarlos0 sorry for the delay, we are using RPM binary from the following docker images:

- registry.access.redhat.com/ubi7/ubi ---> RPM 4.11.3
- registry.access.redhat.com/ubi7/ubi ---> RPM 4.14.3

Both of them failing by that time. 
However I can see now that the issue has been fixed by you 👍 . So I'm no longer able to reproduce this issue from my end.
I guess we can close this now?

Yes, for the time being at least!


Thanks!
